outline: 本課程的目標在使學生了解化工製程安全的重要,並分析實際工安事故,調查分析,以及預防措施
schedule:
Unit 1: Lab safety
Unit 2: Static sparks
Unit 3: High temperature hydrogen attack
Unit 4: Uncontrolled reaction
Unit 5: Runaway reaction
Unit 6: Human Error
Unit 7: Improper design and change
Unit 8: Dust explosion
Unit 9: Hazard of water
Unit 10: Confined space
Unit 10: Hot work hazard
assessment:
課堂作業
報告
期末考試
(暫定)
